title: 🏃 Easy {km}km + light strides at the end
notes: 4x100m strides after the run — form, not speed.

title: 🏃 Tempo — 2km warm + 4km @ T + 2km cool
notes: Tempo effort should feel comfortably hard, not race pace.

title: 🏃 Easy {km}km + 💪 Strength session
notes: Recovery pace run + full-body lifts in the evening.

title: 🛑 REST + mobility 20-30min
notes: Foam roll + hip mobility. Prepare the legs for the long run.

title: 🏃 Long run {km_long}km — steady effort
notes: Fuel + hydrate. Last 20% slightly faster if legs feel good.

title: 🏃 Easy {km}km recovery (or REST if fatigued)
notes: Listen to the body — swap for REST if soreness > 2/10.
